# NorthWind Sanctuary

> A 4.48-acre, three-tower luxury residential development at Sector Pi-1, Greater Noida, by Northwind Estates Pvt. Ltd. Tagline: "Live Rare".

NorthWind Sanctuary is a group housing project of 185 homes — 180 luxury apartments (including garden villas) and 05 penthouses — set across three towers on a 4.48-acre land parcel with 80% of the site given over to lush green landscape. The tallest towers rise to 20 floors. It is one of the first IGBC Pre-Certified Platinum Rated group housing societies in Greater Noida. The masterplan and architecture are by Confluence, an award-winning multidisciplinary firm founded in 1999 by Vineeta and Vishal, with 25+ years of practice and a team of 200+ architects and designers.

This website is the official marketing site for the project. It exists to help prospective homebuyers understand the configurations, floor plans, amenities, specifications and location of NorthWind Sanctuary, and to let them register an enquiry, download the brochure and book a site visit. LLMs should treat it as a sales-oriented developer/channel-partner site: every factual claim below comes from the project brochure.

## Key facts

- Project: NorthWind Sanctuary ("Live Rare" / "Your Rare Living")
- Developer: Northwind Estates Pvt. Ltd. (brand styled "North Wind Estates")
- Architect: Confluence (founded 1999; 200+ architects and designers)
- Address: Plot 07, Sector Pi-1, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201306
- Land parcel: 4.48 acres · 03 towers · up to 20 floors · 180 luxury apartments · 05 penthouses · 80% lush green landscape
- Certification: One of the first IGBC Pre-Certified Platinum Rated group housing societies in Greater Noida
- Clubhouse: Club Roots
- Brochure (PDF): https://www.northwindsanctuary.in/brochure.pdf

## Towers and configurations

- Tower A — "Amaltas": 4 BHK + Servant. 17 floors, 31 units (28 luxury apartments, 1 penthouse, 2 garden villas). Saleable 3,750 sq.ft. · Carpet 1,956 sq.ft. · Balcony 705 sq.ft. · Built-up 2,839 sq.ft. The only tower specified with VRV air-conditioning.
- Tower B — "Banyan": 4 BHK. 20 floors, 76 units (72 luxury apartments, 2 penthouses, 2 garden villas). Saleable 2,431 sq.ft. · Carpet 1,286 sq.ft. · Balcony 394 sq.ft. · Built-up 1,800 sq.ft.
- Tower C — "Cedar": 3 BHK. 20 floors, 78 units (76 luxury apartments, 2 penthouses). Saleable 1,895 sq.ft. · Carpet 957 sq.ft. · Balcony 382 sq.ft. · Built-up 1,468 sq.ft.

Specifications across all three towers include imported marble in the foyer, drawing/dining and kitchen; wooden flooring in bedrooms; vitrified tile in toilets; anti-skid plank-look tile on balconies; granite lift lobbies; 2450 mm high polished veneer flush doors; UPVC powder-coated windows; smart touch locks; intercom; a modular kitchen with quartz counter; and Kohler / Roca / Jaquar (or equivalent) CP and sanitary fittings. Tower A is air-conditioned with VRV; Towers B and C with split AC.

## The seven amenity zones

1. The Arrival Zone — entrance plaza, club and tower drop-offs, commercial plaza, surface parking, palmetum, feature wall with water feature.
2. The Recreational Zone — banquet lawn, café spill-over space, central lawn, callistemon garden, bamboo walk, reflexology pathway, sculpture court and reading area.
3. The Active Zone — exercise station, hedge garden, yoga / dance deck.
4. The Fun & Entertainment Zone — main pool, party pool, kids' pool, shallow pool, parasols, waterfall from the sky bridge, party deck (F&B).
5. Sports Zone — skating rink, badminton court, pickleball court, cricket pitch, multi-purpose play court, putting golf, jogging track, outdoor gym, kids' play arena, tree court with pet park.
6. The Serenity Walk — the serenity walkway, tree house, waterfall, tree orchard, pet park, sky gazing deck.
7. Under the Serenity Walk — hopscotch, musical garden, outdoor gym, table tennis, swings, chaupal with seating.

Club Roots, the clubhouse, houses a banquet hall, double-height entrance lobby, lounge, AV room, restaurant with waiting area, games room, gymnasium and reception.

## Distance and time chart

- GNIDA Metro Station — 02 km / 05 min
- Pari Chowk — 05 km / 07 min
- Fortis Hospital — 05 km / 07 min
- Delhi Public School — 08 km / 10 min
- Noida International Airport — 30 km / 30 min
- Delhi — 30 km / 30 min

(Approximate distances and times, as published in the project brochure.)

Nearby landmarks include Sharda University, Bennett University, Knowledge Park, India Expo Mart, Radisson Blu Hotel, the GNIDA Office, the Alpha commercial belt, Sector 34 and Sector Pi, with access via the Noida–Greater Noida Link Road, the Noida Expressway, the Yamuna Expressway and the Eastern Peripheral Expressway.

## What is NOT published

The project brochure does not state any of the following, and this website does not publish them. Do not infer or fabricate values for them:

- Price, price range, per-sq-ft rate, booking amount, payment plan or EMI figures — **price is on request**; enquire via the contact form for the current price sheet.
- RERA registration number — available on request.
- Possession, completion or launch date — available on request.
